title: palcheck: HOUSE_BODIES/HOST_BODY are dead symbols; header claims a body-hex scan that never runs
detail: Neither constant is referenced by any check; the 1a comment admits wall tones never enter the sprite, so the header's 'house bodies AND roofs' coverage claim is false.
recommended_fix: Delete HOUSE_BODIES/HOST_BODY or add the promised body checks; reword the file header and CI comment to match actual coverage.

title: palcheck: count_exact runs twice per check — every golden rescanned for the printed count
evidence:
+		check(count_exact(calm, HOUSE_ROOFS[i]) > 100, roof_names[i], count_exact(calm, HOUSE_ROOFS[i]))
+	check(count_exact(calm, LED_GREEN) > 10, "puck LEDs", count_exact(calm, LED_GREEN))
detail: Each check scans the full golden twice — condition and printed count — doubling full-image passes for roofs and LEDs.
recommended_fix: Hoist n := count_exact(...) once per color; pass n to check().

title: palcheck restates the banner_y offset formula instead of sharing it
detail: The offset formula now lives in app and harness; a banner_y() spacing tweak silently desyncs the gate, and the substring 'health on' matches comments too.
recommended_fix: Share the formula from the render package (constant or proc beside crisis_banner_rect); parse an explicit directive, not a substring.

title: palcheck banner check fabricates a one-crisis rect; the blessed frame's real crisis count is never derived
evidence:
+		cr: pp.Crisis_State
+		append(&cr.active, pp.Active_Crisis{}) // one row -> the rect math
detail: Rect height assumes exactly one active crisis; with two, top plus side pixels alone exceed 300, so height drift in the blessed frame passes undetected.
recommended_fix: Derive the expected active-crisis count from the replayed demo state instead of a fabricated one-row Crisis_State.

title: Doorstep fan offsets duplicated verbatim in two draw_packets branches
evidence:
+				s := v.tile_px * v.scale
+				kx := f32(int(p.id % 5) - 2) * 0.13 * s
+				ky := f32(int((p.id / 5) % 5)) * 0.11 * s
+				pos = {depart.x - 0.80 * s + kx, depart.y + 0.62 * s + ky}
+				s := v.tile_px * v.scale
+				kx := f32(int(p.id % 5) - 2) * 0.13 * s
+				ky := f32(int((p.id / 5) % 5)) * 0.11 * s
+				pos.x += -0.80 * s + kx
+				pos.y += 0.62 * s + ky
detail: Same magic constants (0.13/0.11/-0.80/0.62) restated in both branches — the copy-drift this diff's band_width/lane_gutter/sla_row_rect refactor exists to prevent.
recommended_fix: Extract one doorstep fan helper (keyed by packet id) used by both the queued and at-node branches.

title: sprite_target_w doc comment names a proc that doesn't exist
evidence:
+// sprite_target_w — the in-game footprint widths (tiles * tile_px * scale).
+sprite_house_target :: proc(v: ^View) -> f32 { return 1.50 * v.tile_px * v.scale }
detail: Doc names sprite_target_w; the actual procs are sprite_house_target, sprite_host_target, sprite_puck_target.
recommended_fix: Update the comment to name the three real procs.

title: Banner card constants (440/17/x formula) still duplicated between crisis_banner_rect and draw_crisis_banner
evidence:
+	card_w := i32(440)
+	pad := i32(10)
+	title_h := i32(20)
+	line_h := i32(17)
 	card_w := i32(440)
 	line_h := i32(17)
 	x := (v.win_w - card_w) / 2
detail: Rect is shared but card_w/line_h/x are restated in the draw's text placement; editing one proc's constants mis-centers text in the other's card.
recommended_fix: Hoist CARD_W/LINE_H/TITLE_H/PAD to package constants consumed by both crisis_banner_rect and draw_crisis_banner.

title: CI/ci-local call tools/harness.sh palcheck but the diff never touches tools/harness.sh
evidence:
+      - name: Sprite/palette presence scan (the look-book §2 palette oracle)
+        run: tools/harness.sh palcheck
detail: New verb exists only in harness/main.odin; the diff has no tools/harness.sh hunk. If the wrapper enumerates verbs rather than passing through, the gate is unwired.
recommended_fix: Add the palcheck case to tools/harness.sh (or confirm it forwards arbitrary verbs to the harness binary).
